label: with integrated URL fix and deployed coordinator

results.name: L1 revocation between claim and batch
results.expected: a batch for a source revoked after claim is rejected; no candidate is staged

results.name: L2 batch parked on org lock, revocation queued
results.expected: staging and revocation queued together: revoked source cannot publish; no open or visible listing
results.observed: stage: {"status":"staged","accepted":1,"candidates_promoted":1}; revoke: 0; publish: ERROR P0001: source_not_publishable; open 0; visible 0

results.name: L3 lease takeover: expired run cannot promote
results.expected: after takeover only the new run promotes; the expired run is rejected with no candidate
results.observed: new run: staged; expired run: {"reason":"stale_batch","status":"rejected"}; candidates P1 0, P2 1

results.name: L4 approval withdrawn and re-granted before old batch
results.expected: a batch collected under the old approval never promotes after re-approval

results.name: L5 partial batch does not withdraw selections
results.expected: partial batch reports partial and does not withdraw an earlier selection
results.observed: partial batch: {"status":"partial","accepted":1,"candidates_promoted":1}; publish P1: published 1, skipped []

results.name: L6 complete batch withdraws absent listings
results.expected: staging never withdraws; a clean complete coordinator settlement closes the absent listing
results.observed: initial publish 1; staged open 1; settled {"closed":1,"reason":null,"run_id":"ba7c7d76-5058-4331-86b3-628291f9e923","status":"complete","skipped":0,"updated":0,"accepted":1,"published":1,"reconciled":true,"blocked_quota":0,"requests_used":"1"}; live P1 open 0

results.name: C1 deselect while publication waits
results.expected: selection queued first takes the shared company lock before publication and prevents publication

results.name: C2 refresh of a selected listing keeps its selection
results.expected: refresh under the granted refresh permission keeps the selection and publishes the refreshed content
results.observed: restage: staged; publish: published 1; live description "Refreshed description"

results.name: C3 selection change behind publication
results.expected: selection change behind a publication: no deadlock or error; publication uses the selection it read

results.name: U1 two companies, one application URL (manual)
results.expected: one company lists the shared URL; the other gets a clean apply_url_already_listed, not an error

results.name: U2a feed batch behind manual claim, one application URL
results.expected: exactly one listing holds the URL; the feed batch keeps its other listing and reports the collision
results.observed: order manual-first; listings for URL 1; feed: {"limit":15,"state":null,"skipped":[{"id":"P1","reason":"apply_url_already_listed"}],"updated":0,"published":1; manual: {"id":"acb4606f-bce5-46b1-b30a-01033f7665cb","job_id":1,"published":true}; P2 open 1

results.name: U2b manual claim behind feed batch, one application URL
results.expected: exactly one listing holds the URL; the feed batch keeps its other listing and reports the collision
results.observed: order feed-first; listings for URL 1; feed: {"limit":15,"state":null,"skipped":[],"updated":0,"published":2,"blocked_quota":0}; manual: {"id":"fbe77b89-a492-4f87-b904-3b4144753020","state":"apply_url_already_listed",; P2 open 1
